# Test captures

Packet captures the engine tests open as trace sessions (`internal/engine/trace_test.go`, `internal/api/trace_contract_test.go`). They are copied unchanged from [otfabric/go-mms-trace](https://github.com/otfabric/go-mms-trace) v0.1.1 (`testdata/`), where their sources are pinned; checksums are in `SHA256SUMS`. They are packet recordings used as test data; their licences are those of their sources.

| File | Copied from (go-mms-trace v0.1.1) | Source | Licence | SHA-256 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `substation.pcap` | `testdata/substation.pcap` | generated by go-mms-trace's tests: four associations (every transaction status, a report, one captured midstream with a lost response), a GOOSE and an SV stream with sequencing issues, one TCP segment on another port | MIT (go-mms-trace) | `45d605515eb57c0264ccca1c548ed7d5819e0793ed37eb82c37f07ac3f6df220` |
| `damaged.pcap` | `testdata/damaged.pcap` | the same capture with the eleventh record's captured length made impossible (`ErrCorrupt` after ten packets) | MIT (go-mms-trace) | `64be628bf5994aa22d3783567b90ecf411d1adbbe7b19a912ed256534b3be143` |
